description: Routes qualified demo requests to the correct sales rep by territory, sends Calendly booking link, creates SLA task, and notifies rep via Slack
use_case: Demo requests need qualification, owner assignment, calendar routing, and Slack alerts

trigger.description: Fires when a lead's 'interested_in' field changes to 'demo_request' OR when a form field is filled

required_inputs: HubSpot custom properties: demo_requested_date, calendar_link_sent, sla_deadline

build_steps.details: Monitor for new contacts where interested_in = 'demo_request'
tips: Use HubSpot Workflows for native integration (preferred)
Alternative: Use Zapier trigger on HubSpot contact updated

build_steps.logic: Use hs_state to look up assigned_owner and calendar_link

build_steps.details: Quick check that calendar link is not empty and contains 'calendly'
build_steps.error_handling: If invalid → Send alert to sales-ops, skip demo request

build_steps.details: Send professional demo invitation with calendar link

task_details.title: Follow up: {firstname} {lastname} - Demo requested
task_details.description: Send demo booking link and calendar. If no response in 24h, call.

build_steps.details: Create reminder task so sales rep has clear action items
Record that demo request was processed and SLA deadline

build_steps.subject: New Demo Request - {{firstname}} {{lastname}} from {{company}}
build_steps.details: Give rep all context they need to act fast
Track all demo requests for reporting
If any step fails (bad email, invalid calendar link, HubSpot API error), log it
build_steps.notification: Email to sales-ops@yourcompany.com with full error details

manual_tests.test_name: Test: CA Territory → West Coast Rep
expected_result: Email sent to test+ca@yourcompany.com with west_coast_rep's Calendly link
Task created in HubSpot assigned to west_coast_rep
Contact property 'calendar_link_sent' = west_coast_rep's link
sla_deadline property set to now + 2 hours
Slack message posted to #sales-demo-requests mentioning west_coast_rep
Email sent to west-coast-rep@yourcompany.com with lead details
manual_tests.how_to_verify: 1. Check sent email folder - should see email to test lead. 2. Open HubSpot contact - check task, check updated properties. 3. Check #sales-demo-requests Slack - should see new message. 4. Check west_coast_rep's inbox - should see notification.

expected_result: Calendar link belongs to south_rep, not west_coast_rep
Task assigned to south_rep
Slack alert mentions south_rep
Email sent to south-rep@yourcompany.com
manual_tests.how_to_verify: Verify all steps use south_rep, not west_coast_rep

expected_result: Automation stops at qualification filter
NO email sent to lead
NO task created
NO Slack alert
Contact NOT updated with demo properties
manual_tests.how_to_verify: 1. HubSpot contact should have NO new tasks. 2. Slack should be silent. 3. Contact properties unchanged.

manual_tests.trigger: Set interested_in = 'demo_request' but calendar_link is empty
expected_result: Automation stops at calendar link validation
NO email sent (cannot include calendar link)
Alert sent to sales-ops@yourcompany.com: 'Missing calendar link for territory CA'
Error logged to Google Sheet error tab
manual_tests.how_to_verify: 1. Check Google Sheet errors - should have entry for missing link. 2. Check sales-ops email - should have alert. 3. No demo email sent to test lead.

manual_tests.trigger: Set interested_in = 'demo_request' with invalid email format
expected_result: Email to lead fails (invalid address)
Error caught and logged
Alert sent to sales-ops: 'Cannot send demo email to invalid-email'
Slack alert still sent (so rep knows lead exists)
Manual correction required: Rep should contact lead via phone
manual_tests.how_to_verify: 1. Error logged in Google Sheet. 2. Alert email to sales-ops. 3. Slack message still posted. 4. Phone number visible in HubSpot for manual follow-up.

common_mistakes.mistake: Calendar link goes to wrong rep
common_mistakes.example: CA lead receives east_coast_rep's Calendly link instead of west_coast_rep
common_mistakes.fix: Check territory mapping logic. Verify hs_state values match your mapping exactly. Test with different states.

common_mistakes.mistake: Task doesn't get assigned to correct owner
common_mistakes.example: Task created but assigned to 'Sales Team Lead' instead of territorial rep
common_mistakes.fix: Verify assigned_owner field is being passed correctly from lookup step. Check HubSpot task creation step includes correct 'assigned_to' value.

common_mistakes.mistake: Slack message has no mention or link
common_mistakes.fix: Add @mention syntax: <@USERID> in Slack message. Get user ID from Slack admin page. Test Slack formatting in Slack directly first.

common_mistakes.example: sla_deadline property shows wrong time or date
common_mistakes.fix: Check timezone settings. Verify 'now + 2 hours' is using same timezone as HubSpot. Consider using a specific time instead (e.g., 9am next day).

common_mistakes.mistake: Automation runs on every contact update
common_mistakes.example: Rep receives same demo request notification multiple times
common_mistakes.fix: Add condition to only trigger on interested_in field change, not all updates. Use 'only when' filter for interested_in = 'demo_request'.

optimization_tips: Add lead scoring: Only route high-scoring leads to reps; lower-scoring leads get sales development rep first
Add workload balancing: If one rep is overloaded, temporarily route to fallback rep
Add SMS option: Send SMS to phone number as alternative to email for faster response
Add calendar sync: Query Calendly to show rep's next available slot in email/Slack message
Add reminder sequences: If demo not booked within 24h, send automatic reminder to lead and escalate to rep's manager
Add meeting notes link: Include link to meeting prep doc or discovery questions template

diagnosis: Check email template contains all required variables {{firstname}}, {{email}}, {{calendar_link}}
Verify email address is not bouncing (check spam list in HubSpot)
Check that trigger is firing (look for task creation)
Verify email sending step is not disabled
troubleshooting.resolution: Send a test email manually first to verify template works, then re-enable automation

daily_checks: Did all reps receive their notifications?
weekly_kpis: Avg time from request to booking (hours)
SLA compliance (% of reps responding within 2 hours)
Distribution of demos by rep (even load?)
monthly_kpis: Avg time to demo (days from lead to actual meeting)

dependencies: HubSpot CRM with custom properties (demo_requested_date, calendar_link_sent, sla_deadline)
Zapier or Make.com or native HubSpot Workflows
Calendly account with individual calendars per rep
Gmail account for sending rep notifications
handoff_notes: After 1 week, measure booking rate. If <50%, review email copy and calendar links.
After 2 weeks, check SLA compliance. Are reps responding within 2 hours? Adjust deadline if too tight.
Monthly, review demo → proposal conversion. If low, add prep materials or discovery questions to booking email.
Quarterly, review territory load. Are some territories getting more demos than others? Balance routing rules if needed.
